rules.summary: In weeks when public schools are in session, children under 16 may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on other days and 18 hours a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: W. Va. Code § 21-6-7 — Hours and days of labor by minors
citation.excerpt: More than three hours per day, on days in which public schools are in session; (4) More than eighteen hours per week, in weeks in which public schools are in session

rules.summary: In weeks when public schools are not in session, children under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: W. Va. Code § 21-6-7 — Hours and days of labor by minors
citation.excerpt: More than eight hours, on days in which public schools are not in session; or (6) More than forty hours per week, in weeks in which public schools are not in session
